name: Sovereign Street, Northern End
desc1: This is a cobblestoned street. It is dimly lit by guttering lanterns
desc2: hung from tall posts. It continues to the north and south. Banners
desc3: hung from the posts flutter gaily in the breeze. The wide steel doors
desc4: of the Bank of Godfrey stand open to the west, and a steady stream of
desc5: people pass through their mouth. To the east, the door of the Homely
desc6: Hearth reveals the sounds of merriment and clanking crockery, and you
desc7: can smell the heavenly scent of cooking food.
